mapper.select: SELECT c.course_id as courseId, c.title, c.type as typeCode, t.name as teacherName, DATE_FORMAT(c.start_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') as startTime, DATE_FORMAT(c.end_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') as endTime, c.price as priceCents, c.description FROM courses c LEFT JOIN teachers t ON c.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE c.is_open = true AND c.start_time > NOW() AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.start_time ASC
